SELECT CASE action_type WHEN '101' THEN 'not patentable subject matter (101)' WHEN '102' THEN 'not new (102)' WHEN '103' THEN 'obvious (103)' WHEN '112' THEN 'unclear or unsupported (112)' ELSE action_type END AS ground, count(*) AS rejections FROM govblock_patents.oa_research_rejections GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was the average day-ahead power price in the Capital zone in 2021?
Nyiso Lmp Day Ahead Hourly Mlbmp Zone
SELECT avg(try_cast(lbmp_mwhr AS double)) AS average FROM govblock_solar.nyiso_lmp_day_ahead_hourly_mlbmp_zone WHERE name = 'CAPITL' AND substr(time_stamp, 7, 4) = '2021'
What products are sold under wholesale electricity contracts?
SELECT product_name, count(*) AS contract_lines FROM govblock_energy.ferceqr_contracts WHERE year_quarter LIKE '2024%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many home health agency cost reports were filed for fiscal 2023?
SELECT count(DISTINCT rpt_rec_num) AS n FROM govblock_health.hcris_hha20_nmrc WHERE cast(hcris_fy AS varchar) = '2023'
Which federal departments funded the research behind the most published patent applications?
SELECT level_one AS department, count(DISTINCT pgpub_id) AS applications FROM govblock_patents.pv_pg_gov_interest_org GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of long-stay residents in Texas nursing homes have pressure ulcers, on average?

SELECT avg(try_cast(four_quarter_average_score AS double)) AS average FROM govblock_health.cc_nh_qualitymsr_mds WHERE resident_type = 'Long Stay' AND provider_state = 'TX' AND lower(measure_description) LIKE '%pressure ulcer%'
Which exclusion programs account for the most debarred entities?
SELECT exclusion_program, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_awards.sam_exclusions GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of applications were examined under the first-inventor-to-file rules of the America Invents Act?
SELECT round(100.0 * count_if(aia_first_to_file = 'Y') / count(*), 1) AS pct_first_to_file FROM govblock_patents.patex_application_data_25 WHERE aia_first_to_file IN ('Y', 'N')
Which states employ the most public school teachers?

SELECT statename, round(sum(try_cast(teachers AS double))) AS teachers FROM govblock_education.ccd_sch_059 WHERE school_year = '2024-2025' AND total_indicator = 'Education Unit Total' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many Service Contract Act wage determinations are active today?
SELECT count(DISTINCT wd_number) AS determinations FROM govblock_awards.sam_wage_determinations WHERE kind = 'sca' AND is_active = 'Y'
Where do families wait longest to get into subsidized housing?

SELECT name, states, try_cast(months_waiting AS double) AS months_waiting FROM govblock_housing.hud_psh_county WHERE program_label = 'Summary of All HUD Programs' AND try_cast(total_units AS double) >= 1000 ORDER BY 3 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

Which journals have published the most high-energy physics papers?
SELECT journal_title, count(*) AS papers FROM govblock_scholarly.inspire_literature WHERE coalesce(journal_title, '') <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

Where in New York state, city by city, did deadly crashes happen most often in 2022?
SELECT cityname, count(*) AS crashes FROM govblock_vehicles.fars_accident WHERE statename = 'New York' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2022' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many registered trials were withdrawn before enrolling anyone?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.ct_studies WHERE overall_status = 'WITHDRAWN'
Which cities in Texas have the most companies registered to do business with the federal government?
SELECT physical_address_city, count(*) AS entities FROM govblock_awards.sam_entities WHERE physical_address_province_or_state = 'TX' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many deposited substance records map to caffeine?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_compound_cid_sid WHERE c0 = '2519'
Which states deposited the most into the Unemployment Trust Fund in 2019?

SELECT acct_desc AS state, abs(sum(try_cast(shares_per_par AS double))) AS deposited FROM govblock_treasury.utf_account_statement WHERE report_type = 'State' AND trans_desc_cd LIKE '11-10%' AND substr(cast(eff_date AS varchar), 1, 4) = '2019' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many homes in Detroit stand vacant?
SELECT value FROM govblock_census.acs5_2024 WHERE geo_id = '1600000US2622000' AND variable = 'B25002_E003'
At which companies did insiders give away the most shares as gifts in 2023?

SELECT s.issuername, sum(try_cast(t.trans_shares AS double)) AS shares_gifted FROM govblock_sec.sec_insider_nonderiv_trans t JOIN govblock_sec.sec_insider_submission s ON s.accession_number = t.accession_number WHERE t.trans_code = 'G' AND t.trans_date LIKE '%-2023' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How has New York State's yearly average unemployment rate moved over the past decade?
SELECT year, value AS rate FROM govblock_labor.bls_la_data WHERE series_id = 'LAUST360000000000003' AND period = 'M13' ORDER BY year DESC LIMIT 10
Which states bought the most electricity at retail in 2020?

SELECT column06 AS state, round(sum(try_cast(sales_4 AS double))) AS mwh FROM govblock_energy.eia861_sales_ult_cust_sheet_states WHERE column00 = '2020' AND column03 IN ('A', 'B') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was the average WTI spot price across 2008?
SELECT round(avg(try_cast(value AS double)), 2) AS dollars_per_barrel FROM govblock_energy.eia_pet_data WHERE series_id = 'PET.RWTC.D' AND period LIKE '2008%'
In which states were the most judges born?
SELECT dob_state, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_courts.people_db_people WHERE dob_state <> '' AND dob_state IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many patent applications did the USPTO publish each year, most recent first?
SELECT substr(published_date, 1, 4) AS year, count(*) AS published FROM govblock_patents.pv_pg_published_application GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 10
Which organisations own stakes in the most Medicare nursing facilities?

SELECT organization_name_owner, count(DISTINCT enrollment_id) AS facilities FROM govblock_health.cms_skilled_nursing_facility_all_owners WHERE type_owner = 'O' AND organization_name_owner IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Did more U.S. exports to China go by air or by sea in 2018?
SELECT max(try_cast(air_val_yr AS double)) AS by_air, max(try_cast(ves_val_yr AS double)) AS by_vessel FROM govblock_trade.census_exp_cty WHERE cty_name = 'CHINA' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2018'
Which ZIP codes in New York City complain to the FCC the most?
SELECT zip, count(*) AS complaints FROM govblock_consumer.fcc_consumer_complaints WHERE state = 'NY' AND city = 'New York' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was the highest five-minute load in the Hudson Valley zone in 2021?
SELECT max(try_cast(load AS double)) AS highest FROM govblock_solar.nyiso_load_pal WHERE name = 'HUD VL' AND substr(time_stamp, 7, 4) = '2021'
Which states had the largest total personal income in 2024?

SELECT geoname, try_cast(_2024 AS double) AS income_thousands FROM govblock_economy.bea_cainc1 WHERE linecode = '1' AND geofips LIKE '%000' AND geofips BETWEEN '01000' AND '56000' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How did the Supreme Court vote in Brown v. Board of Education?
SELECT case_name, date_filed, scdb_votes_majority, scdb_votes_minority FROM govblock_courts.opinion_clusters WHERE case_name LIKE 'Brown v. Board of Education%' LIMIT 5
What kinds of facility report the most events to the NRC?
SELECT category, count(*) AS events FROM govblock_reactors.nrc_event_notifications GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
On average, what share of assets do large multiemployer pension plans hold in stocks?
SELECT avg(try_cast(pen_stock_prcnt AS double)) AS average FROM govblock_nonprofits.dol_f_sch_r WHERE pen_stock_prcnt IS NOT NULL
Why do judges leave their posts, and how often for each reason?
SELECT termination_reason, count(*) AS positions FROM govblock_courts.people_db_positions WHERE coalesce(termination_reason, '') <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How are computed materials split by the number of elements they contain?
SELECT nelements, count(*) AS materials FROM govblock_materials.mp_summary GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 10
Which states had the most candidates for the U.S. House in 2022?
SELECT cand_office_st, count(DISTINCT cand_id) AS candidates FROM govblock_fec.candidates WHERE cand_office = 'H' AND cast(cand_election_yr AS varchar) = '2022' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many federal loans were made in fiscal 2022?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_db_rpt_award_search WHERE category = 'loans' AND cast(fiscal_year AS varchar) = '2022'
In which years were the most nuclear reactor projects cancelled?
SELECT canceled_date AS year, count(*) AS cancelled FROM govblock_reactors.nrc_dataset_reactors_canceled_query_5 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much did Pfizer pay doctors and teaching hospitals in 2020?

SELECT sum(try_cast(total_amount_of_payment_usdollars AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_health.op_general WHERE submitting_applicable_manufacturer_or_applicable_gpo_name LIKE 'Pfizer%' AND cast(program_year AS varchar) = '2020'
